title: A Charlie Brown Christmas Live on Stage
seo_title: A Charlie Brown Christmas Live on Stage in Springfield
description: A Charlie Brown Christmas Live on Stage is a touring theater production in which Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Lucy, Linus and the Peanuts gang put on their own Christmas play, adapted from Charles M. Schulz's animated TV special with music by Vince Guaraldi. It is intended for the whole family, and every patron needs a ticket regardless of age. It takes place Sunday, December 20, 2026 at 7:00 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
